slides.lead: Swipe. Here’s what the World Health Organization says.

slides.headline: Nobody can read your history *off your body.*
slides.body: Whatever you have or haven’t done, no test can tell. And it was never anyone else’s to inspect.

slides.headline: So many of us grew up *afraid of being “found out”.*
slides.body: That fear rested on something that was never true. You’re allowed to put it down.

slides.headline: No test can tell. *Your body’s history is yours to share, or not.*
slides.lead: Send this to the friend who needs to hear it.

captions.instagram:
Myth: you can tell if a woman is a virgin.

The World Health Organization, UN Human Rights and UN Women said it together in 2018: there is no examination that can prove a girl or woman has had sex.

So many of us grew up afraid of being “found out”. That fear rested on something that was never true. Whatever you have or haven’t done, nobody can read it off your body, and it was never anyone else’s to inspect.

Your body’s history is yours to share, or not.

Send this to the friend who needs to hear it.

Source: WHO, UN Human Rights and UN Women, interagency statement, 17 Oct 2018.

#MythVsFact #NoShame #BodyConfidence #SexualWellness #WomensHealth #Intimova
